notes.title: 关于游戏内容的争议
notes.notes:
1. About Wang Xiangxiu's death in prison:

When I was studying, I only looked at bad luck and good luck. For example, Jin Kemu, I defeated me as a prisoner, and Jin was a prisoner



2. It is unreasonable to simply use bad luck, add or subtract bad luck, and take 60% as A Dun instead of all B:

There is no solution in the game, so we can calculate the results with bad luck. We can use this as the original game playing method. In reality, we calculate the results with solutions. The problem with Jia Dun is that in the process of taking bad luck and good luck, it is also an original play method. Because the relationship between the five elements is that both A and B are wood, it is fixed to take B, and the median symbol in the array is still in the 60s.



3. Incorrect monthly expenditure:

Because the perpetual calendar cannot be quoted in the game, the Gan Zhi chronology method in the game has been calculated in a program with errors, and the subsequent game prizes hide the Gan Zhi year and Gan Zhi month, which is also not used in the dish arrangement. In reality, you can directly query the perpetual calendar.



There is no problem with the layout of the game. Most of the comments and feedback from the group are original game play method "calculating bad luck", which is original game play method. In reality, it is to use the solution to calculate the results. Finally, thank you for your support.
